content: XDG GlobalShortcuts portal: BindShortcuts takes a per-shortcut vardict of {description, preferred_trigger}; preferred_trigger is a suggestion only. The response returns {description, trigger_description} where trigger_description is a human-readable string of the trigger the BACKEND/USER actually chose, not the app's request. There is no machine-readable binding in the reply. ListShortcuts returns the currently bound set (or shortcuts bound in prior sessions if BindShortcuts has not been called this session). ShortcutsChanged fires when the compositor changes bindings behind the app's back; Activated carries an optional activation_token. An app may only call BindShortcuts once per session. Correct read-back pattern: never echo preferred_trigger to the user; display trigger_description from the BindShortcuts reply, refresh it from ListShortcuts and from every ShortcutsChanged, and treat 'effective binding' as a display-only string that cannot be parsed back into keys.
